seoTitle: Top IPs and User Agents Report from Access Logs
metaDescription: Rank busy client IPs and user agents with request counts, share, bytes, errors and first and last request. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Two rankings from a Common or Combined log: client IPs and user agents.
why:
Which client causes most of the load? The answer is often one IP or one library user agent. Each row shows requests, share, bytes, 4xx and 5xx counts and the time range.

A user agent is a claim by the client and can be faked. Many requests from one IP may be a proxy with many users.
howTo: Paste the access log or choose a file.
